The '''Essential Miner's Gear''' was a [[mining tool kit]] produced by [[TasCorp]]. The kit provided all of the non-powered equipment a [[Miner/Legends|miner]] needed to successfully operate on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tasariq]]. Widely used by the [[Tasari]] and off-worlders, the kit was a backpack that included basic excavation tools, a week's worth of dried [[Ration pack/Legends|rations]], a [[Breath mask/Legends|breath mask]], and two personal [[oxygen tank]]s.<ref name="J15" />
